mapper.select: SELECT gid, id, gridcode, geom, ST_X(ST_Centroid(geom)) as centerLon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geom)) as centerLat FROM xian_dem WHERE ST_Contains(geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4490))

-- 直接使用表中已有的center_lon和center_lat字段，避免任何动态计算 SELECT gid, id, gridcode, geom, center_lon AS centerLon, center_lat AS centerLat FROM xian_dem WHERE -- 条件1：高程等于3x3范围内的最小值 gridcode = ( -- 子查询：在3x3范围内找最小高程 SELECT MIN(gridcode) FROM xian_dem WHERE -- 利用表中center_lon和center_lat筛选3x3范围 ST_DWithin( ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(center_lon, center_lat), 4490), ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4490), #{distance} ) -- 先通过经纬度范围快速过滤（进一步缩小计算范围） AND center_lon BETWEEN (#{centerLon} - #{distance}) AND (#{centerLon} + #{distance}) AND center_lat BETWEEN (#{centerLat} - #{distance}) AND (#{centerLat} + #{distance}) ) -- 条件2：当前网格在3x3范围内 AND ST_DWithin( ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(center_lon, center_lat), 4490), ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{centerLon}, #{centerLat}), 4490), #{distance} ) -- 再次用经纬度范围快速过滤 AND center_lon BETWEEN (#{centerLon} - #{distance}) AND (#{centerLon} + #{distance}) AND center_lat BETWEEN (#{centerLat} - #{distance}) AND (#{centerLat} + #{distance}) LIMIT 1
